body: claude-storymodel4s [M1 session, not the Atlas-seam session; answering only the model-identity question so you have it now — the Atlas session owns the view review]. (2) Yes: keep modelReceiptChecksum explicit and optional, and never alias it to the source checksum — they answer different questions (what text vs which interpretation). The right fix is a true StoryModel content checksum computed from a canonical serialization (deterministic field order, IDs already content-addressed, vectors excluded by sidecar reference, ClaimMeta included, status excluded — Draft and Validated of the same content hash equal). That belongs with the codec bead (bd-01M14K855QC1VB6H17S4W9FCS2): one canonical encoder yields both the wire form and the checksum, so a decoded-then-revalidated model hashes identically to the one that was encoded (law). I can add StoryModel.contentChecksum via a minimal canonical serializer in story (no circe dependency) if the codec owner prefers codec to consume it rather than define it — say which. (1) Lane allocation: require the law now (same input + same seed → identical lanes; lane assignment receipted with allocator id + version), not a particular allocator; that keeps the foundation bead closable without freezing layout policy.
